scope: R4 changed regions and affected shots, inspected as stills and ordered frames. No full real-time screening or new listening review claimed.

Native crops from 109.6 to 112 seconds show closed, half-open, and open mouth shapes without rectangular backing.
Native crops from 118 to 120.467 seconds show mouth changes and a closed-eye state. Glasses, eyebrows, and beard remain connected; no rectangular edge observed.
Native crops near 37 seconds show open eyes, a single closed-lash shape, and reopening. Mouth changes have no rectangular edge.
At 352 to 362 seconds the eyebrows change from concern to determination and tearful eyes. The 358-second blink has no old open-eye outline above the lashes.
Body-cel crops at 214, 214.2, and 215 seconds show open and closed mouths. Another cel speaks at 332 seconds, but those three similar shapes alone do not demonstrate a full mouth cycle.
Native crops at 304 seconds show blinking combined with an open mouth without a rectangular patch; eyelids return to their original positions.

At 235.5 to 238 seconds the stair and rising particles develop. The face and mouth remain readable through silver particles at 369.5 to 370.5 seconds. The final-section cast and subtitles are legible.
